title: Work products by level and responsibility
description: A matrix crosses L1 narrative, L2 semi-structured, L3 computable, and L4 local implementation with Data, Clinical logic, and Forms. Each cell preserves the planning work products described in Guideline Artifacts. The level colors match the adjacent representation-level diagram. The page provides the full matrix as accessible text. Representation levels are not conformance grades, and a capability may not need a form.
